KenshiCoopTrio - three-player co-op for Kenshi
==============================================

EASIEST WAY
-----------
  Double-click INSTALL.cmd. It finds Kenshi, copies the mod in, and asks
  for the Steam IDs. That's it.

  (No admin needed. It only writes into Kenshi's own mods folder.)


IF YOU'D RATHER DO IT BY HAND
-----------------------------
  Drag the "KenshiCoop" folder into your Kenshi "mods" folder, so you get:

    <Kenshi>\mods\KenshiCoop\KenshiCoop.dll

  Default location:
    C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Kenshi\mods\


BEFORE IT WILL WORK - ALL THREE OF YOU
--------------------------------------
  1. RE_Kenshi installed (free - it's what loads the co-op plugin):
       https://github.com/BFrizzleFoShizzle/RE_Kenshi/releases/latest

  2. Kenshi in WINDOWED mode:
       Options > Video > uncheck Full Screen

  3. Steam running and ONLINE (not offline mode).

  4. Enable "KenshiCoop" in Kenshi's Mods menu.

  5. Everyone runs the SAME build. Different builds = "protocol mismatch".


THE STEAM ID SWAP (this is the part people get wrong)
-----------------------------------------------------
  Press F2 in game, click "Copy my Steam ID", send it to the others.

    HOST  needs BOTH joins' IDs.
    JOINS need ONLY the host's ID.

  The joins do NOT need each other's IDs - the host passes everything
  between them. That relay is the whole reason this fork exists.

  INSTALL.cmd writes this for you. To edit it later, open:
    <Kenshi>\mods\KenshiCoop\coop_config.json

    {
      "transport":  "steam",
      "steamPeer":  "76561198000000001",   <- join 1 (host only)
      "steamPeer2": "76561198000000002"    <- join 2 (host only)
    }

  Joins leave out "steamPeer2" entirely.


PLAYING
-------
  HOST : load a save, split your units into THREE squad tabs, press F2,
         Role = HOST, Connection = ONLINE.
  JOINS: from the MAIN MENU (no save needed), press F2,
         Role = JOIN, Connection = ONLINE.

  The host streams its world to you automatically.
  You each control your own squad - tab 1 = host, tab 2 and 3 = joins.


IF SOMETHING'S WRONG
--------------------
  Logs are at:  <Kenshi>\KenshiCoop_*.log

  "co-op plugin has not started"   RE_Kenshi didn't load it. Reinstall it.
  "protocol mismatch"              someone has a different build.
  third player never connects      host's config is missing "steamPeer2".
                                   The host log should say "2 tunnel peer(s)".
  "dropping packets from
   unexpected peer"                that Steam ID isn't in the host's config.


HEADS UP
--------
  This is experimental. The two-player mod it's built on says to expect
  desyncs and crashes; a third player adds more of both. Save often.

  Source: https://github.com/LogoutUser/KenshiCoopTrio
  Built on nhoral/KenshiCoop. AGPL-3.0 - if you pass this on, pass the
  source link on with it.
